item.title: Countdown Into Neon Night

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical ad for Neon Night, 12 September 2026 at The Foundry, Leeds. Start with a big 3, 2, 1 countdown, building electronic beats and flashing neon, then reveal the event name, date and venue. Hold that end card so I can read it. No talking.

item.tests: Checks a visible descending countdown, synchronized musical buildup, and a readable event reveal rather than a static promo.

answer_sheet.Event wording: Neon Night; 12 September 2026; The Foundry, Leeds
answer_sheet.Countdown: Show 3, then 2, then 1 before revealing the event details.
answer_sheet.Style and pacing: Flashing neon and building electronic beats; hold the final details for at least 3 seconds.
answer_sheet.Language and voice: English text, no talking or voiceover.

must_haves: The video is 8 seconds long in 9:16.
Large numerals appear in the order '3', '2', '1', followed by the event reveal.
Electronic music builds during the countdown, with audible accents matching the numeral changes.
Neon lighting or graphics visibly change during the countdown.
The final card shows 'Neon Night', '12 September 2026' and 'The Foundry, Leeds' together for at least 3 seconds, without clipped text.

goal.why: The user requests a complete event advertisement with a countdown and end-card reveal.

plan.say: I’ll make three bold neon countdown cards and an event end card, then assemble them with flashing transitions and building electronic beats. I’ll hold the event details for the final five seconds so they’re easy to read.

params.prompt_or_change: High-contrast neon club poster design on black, electric cyan and hot pink light streaks framing a single enormous bold white numeral "3" in the centre; keep all lettering within the middle 80%, no other words.
Keep the neon poster style, background, colours and composition unchanged; replace the central numeral with an equally enormous bold white "2", with no other words.
Keep the neon poster style, background, colours and composition unchanged; replace the central numeral with an equally enormous bold white "1", with no other words.

steps.why: Complete the countdown in the same visual style.

params.prompt_or_change: Keep the high-contrast black, electric cyan and hot pink neon club poster style; remove the countdown numeral and replace it with centred designed lettering: enormous bold white "Neon Night" above clearly readable white "12 September 2026" and "The Foundry, Leeds"; keep every word within the middle 80%, with generous spacing and neon accents only around the edges.

steps.why: Create a matching, legible event reveal.

params.extra: Generate at least 15 seconds if required, then cut an 8-second section with the reveal hit at 3 seconds.
params.prompt_or_change: Instrumental electronic club beats: three rising countdown pulses over the first three seconds, a strong reveal hit at three seconds, then energetic driving synths through eight seconds; no voices, lyrics or spoken countdown.

steps.why: Supply the requested electronic build without speech.

params.extra: Timing: countdown_3 0–1 s; countdown_2 1–2 s; countdown_1 2–3 s; event_end_card 3–8 s. Use brief neon brightness pulses at countdown cuts, not rapid strobing; keep the end card steady and fully readable. No speech.
params.prompt_or_change: Assemble the four supplied cards in order with the electronic track, beat-synchronised countdown cuts, brief neon flashes at transitions, and a continuous five-second event end-card hold.

steps.why: Combine the countdown, flashing neon and music into the final ad while preserving a five-second reading hold.
